notes: enabled: uploads happen only when true (on since the secrets were set; Google no longer locks API uploads of unaudited projects as private, so no audit is needed: production/YOUTUBE.md, step 7). follow_release_schedule: premiere each episode at its slot in production/schedule.json (the same moment the wiki and the GitHub release go public); `schedule` is only the fallback for a slot that has already passed. category 20 = Gaming. weekdays: 0 = Monday. max_per_run: uploads per run (the nightly run, and the run after each new story release); the queue goes in order of publish time across the story and every series. playlist_id: the story's episodes (shorts_playlist_id: its Shorts, if set). series: other shows whose uploads (times, titles, descriptions, tags) come from a plan file in their GitHub release; every upload goes to the series' playlist. An upload without a time in the plan waits until `times` gives it one, e.g. {"e11-trailer": "2026-11-24 18:00"} (local time); `times` also overrides a plan time. retext: find/replace rules applied to every description, at upload and (each run, after its command) to the videos already on YouTube; a rule that no longer matches costs nothing. Added 25 Oct 2026: Act 1 of the story ended with Episode 10 (no more weekday episodes for now) and the Pit's T-Rex bonus got a date (Wed 25 Nov, from the pit-s1 plan) instead of the 100-subscriber unlock. Changed 15 Nov 2026: the channel was renamed Timeslip Ramen (@TimeslipRamenShop). story: false turns the story's uploads off; The Pit (enabled: false) gets no more uploads, and its uploads that were still scheduled were unscheduled (private, no publish time; `unschedule --series=pit-s1`). Series tsr-s1 uploads Timeslip Ramen Season 1 from Nat20-Pixel-Saga/TimeSlipRamen: plan = docs/upload-schedule.json on its main branch, videos and thumbnails from its releases (week-1 ... week-4, channel-kit), category 1 = Film & Animation, its playlists created on the channel the first time they are needed (ids kept in wiki/data/youtube-playlists.json). Shorts get no custom thumbnail (YouTube allows it only for Partner Program channels). The trailer's 14 Nov slot had passed, so `times` moves it to Mon 16 Nov 12:00. daily_quota_budget: units of YouTube's shared 10,000-a-day pool the runs may spend per Pacific day (thumbnails, playlists, updates: 50 each), counted in wiki/data/youtube-quota.json; a run stops before an upload that would pass it. Uploads themselves have had their own bucket since June 2026 (100 a day). max_per_run 3 from 15 Nov: Timeslip Ramen needs about 1.5 uploads a day, so the queue gets ahead.
